name: [🏆] Endless Tower Defense
desc:
🏆 Use Code "FREEGIFT" and Like for free Rewards!

🔥 How long can you survive?

🎲 SUMMON & UPGRADE – Build your team with powerful Units and upgrade them to reach new limits.
⚔️ ENDLESS WAVES – No final wave. Enemies get stronger the longer you survive!
👑 RANDOM BOSSES – A random Boss appears every 5 waves. Stay prepared!
🏆 WEEKLY LEADERBOARD REWARDS – Compete for the top spots and earn weekly rewards.
⚔️ RANKED PVP – Fight other players, climb the ranks and prove your team is the best!
🔄 WEEKLY UPDATES – New content, features and more every week!

🔥 Survive. Upgrade. Compete. How far can you go?
